sentences.en: The quality of salmon being sold here is the best.
sentences.zh: 这里出售的鲑鱼质量是最好的。

sentences.en: The run up the river can be exhausting for salmon.
sentences.zh: 逆流而上的旅程对于鲑鱼来说非常疲惫。

sentences.en: Fish ladders help salmon bypass man-made obstacles, such as dams.
sentences.zh: 鱼梯帮助鲑鱼绕过人造障碍，比如水坝。

senses.zh: 鲑鱼；大马哈鱼；鲑肉色；鲑鱼肉；橙红色，粉橙色
